data.exact_reserve_text: IQUW Holdings, through a subsidiary, participated on the 2022 and 2021 years of account. The result for the 2022 and 2021 years of account is a loss of GBP 12.2 million. Capacity for the 2020 & prior years of account is backed by Credit Suisse and Humboldt Re Limited. The result for the 2020 and prior underwriting years in calendar year 2022 was a loss of GBP 1.5 million. The 2020 and prior result included an additional GBP 5.6 million risk premium above the core best estimate reserve in order to close the year into the 2021 year of account.

data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2022 were GBP 166.4m. Analysis of the gross claims development triangle indicates a small net prior-year gross strengthening of approximately GBP 1.5m (c.0.9% of opening reserves), driven primarily by adverse development on the 2020 underwriting year (partly reflecting COVID-19 related exposures and an explicit GBP 5.6m risk premium added to close 2020 & prior years). Other older underwriting years showed some favourable development, leaving a slight net strengthening. The syndicate also experienced significant 2022 catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Ian) which materially impacted the 2022 underwriting result but are current-year events.
raw_causal_phrases: The 2020 and prior result included an additional GBP 5.6 million risk premium above the core best estimate reserve in order to close the year into the 2021 year of account.

The Syndicate has exposure on the 2019 and 2020 underwriting years to losses arising out of COVID and currently has reserved GBP 21.6 million gross of reinsurance and GBP 21.6 million net of reinsurance (2021: GBP 19.1million gross and GBP 19.1 million net).
The result for the 2020 and prior underwriting years in calendar year 2022 was a loss of GBP 1.5 million.
The 2022 result was materially impacted by the Russia-Ukraine Conflict (GBP 19.7million) and catastrophe events in the year, including claims arising from Hurricane Ian (GBP 56.9 million).
We have explicitly considered economic and excess inflation in the reserving process when setting the best estimate reserves

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development (PYD) gross figure was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (gross cumulative ultimate amounts) as no explicit 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross total was published. The syndicate documents an RITC of 2020 & prior into the 2021 YOA and an added GBP 5.6m risk premium to close 2020 & prior years; these transactions can distort triangle-based PYD calculations. Therefore PYD is computed from the triangle (gross) and flagged with 0.8 confidence. Amounts throughout are reported in millions converted from the report's GBP 000 presentation.
